VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 96 tests pass and describes a plausible fix (timezone conversion), there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly require "all 96 tests pass" and proper timezone handling—both of which require objective verification beyond self-attestation.
